title: serapias orientalis subsp. cycladum
intro: Serapias orientalis subsp. cycladum, commonly known as the Mediterranean orchid or Greek orchid, is a rare, subterranean orchid species. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Serapias orientalis subsp. cycladum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
